draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kappad! A stone monument here reads 'Vasco da Gama landed here, Kappakadavu, in the year 1498', and today it's a Blue Flag beach.
draft.hungryLine: The beach park has its own restaurant, handy for a bite between sea breezes.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Vasco da Gama memorial is a 12 min walk away, the stone that marks the 1498 landing.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Grab a seat in the beachside park or stroll the corniche and watch the sea.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The corniche and park came from a Rs. 1.5 crore beautification programme launched in 2007.

spots.name: Vasco da Gama memorial
spots.detail: 12 min walk · The stone marking the 1498 landing

tips.title: Take the train to Koyilandy.
tips.body: It's the nearest major railway station, about 10 km from Kappad.

tips.title: Hop off at Thiruvangoor.
tips.body: Buses on National Highway 66 between Kozhikode and Vadakara stop there, and you can reach the beach from it.

story.title: A famous landing
story.body: A government stone monument at Kappakadavu commemorates the landing of Vasco da Gama in 1498.

story.title: A makeover
story.body: Kerala's Tourism Minister Kodiyeri Balakrishnan launched a Rs. 1.5 crore programme to beautify the beach. It gave Kappad a corniche and a park with seating and a restaurant.

story.title: Blue Flag beach
story.body: Kappad now holds Blue Flag status, a quiet beach and village near Koyilandy.
